assets.defect_engineered: the printed card reads as five tidy blocks (name, INCI panel, claim, price, product-image well) but the PRODUCT NAME, the INCI block and the CLEARED CLAIM are set as ONE continuous threaded story across three linked frames, so the INCI is an offset inside a continuous flow rather than an addressable field and offsets read off the mapping readout (which normalises and shortens the story) silently drop or misplace the INCI while validation/prepare/render all report success; the square image well IS a real bindable graphic frame and a 3 mm bleed box IS present so press-ready-with-bleed can be honoured
assets.content:
LAYOUT SPEC for the specialty chain's per-SKU shelf-edge / tester-station spec card press PDF (flat, single record; to be reverse-engineered downstream).

Document: single card, 105 x 148 mm (A6) PORTRAIT, 3 mm bleed box present on all four sides, trim marks, fonts embedded. This is the flat proof the chain's print vendor supplied as the template each SKU card is struck from.

WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE PRINTED (appears as five tidy blocks):
- Top: the PRODUCT NAME in the display cut, large, on a Clinical White ground.
- A thin Signal Blue hairline rule under the name.
- A boxed INGREDIENTS (INCI) block in the grotesque, small, set in a panel with a faint Cool Mineral Grey keyline.
- Under it: the CLEARED CLAIM line in the grotesque, one line, Graphite.
- Bottom-left: the PRICE, large, in the display cut.
- Top-right: a square PRODUCT IMAGE well showing the bottle on white.

HOW IT IS ACTUALLY SET (the reverse-engineering trap):
- The PRODUCT NAME, the INCI block and the CLEARED CLAIM are ONE continuous THREADED story flowing through three linked text frames (name frame -> INCI panel frame -> claim frame), NOT three addressable fields. The apparent 'boxed INCI panel' is a threaded frame in the middle of that flow, and the INCI text is an offset INSIDE the continuous story, not a field of its own.
- The PRICE sits in its own separate short story frame.
- The square PRODUCT IMAGE well IS a real rectangular graphic frame (a picture can be bound into it), fitted to fill.
- The Signal Blue rule and the Cool Mineral Grey keyline are decorative vector paths, not frames.
- So the frame inventory a conversion exposes (roughly: one threaded story across three linked frames + one short price story + one graphic frame + two decorative paths) is nothing like the five tidy fields the printed card suggests, and the INCI is reachable ONLY as an offset computed from the reconstructed continuous story.

BLEED: a 3 mm bleed box is present on all sides, so a press-ready-with-bleed delivery CAN be honoured from this file when the render is called at trim + bleed; deliveries must carry the bleed rather than trimming it away.

FIELD LABELS the downstream mapping must resolve (present as content, not visible tokens): PRODUCT_NAME | INCI | CLAIM | PRICE | PRODUCT_IMAGE

Colours: Clinical White #F4F6F7 ground, Graphite #232729 name and claim, Cool Mineral Grey #9BA5AA keyline, Signal Blue #3E6076 rule.
